name: The Inkwell

size.relative: Fits in two teen hands; roughly the height of a large jam jar
size.dimensions_approx: About 10–12 cm tall including lid; 7–8 cm wide at the belly
size.visual_read: Small enough to cradle against the chest when wrapped; large enough to be a clear hero prop in medium shots

material.body: Dark smoked glass with subtle thickness; not perfectly clear
material.base: Short metal or aged brass foot ring
material.lid: Fitted lid with a small knob; metal with soft patina
material.ink: Deep black ink that looks denser than ordinary calligraphy ink; occasional faint shimmer when active

silhouette: Classic round-bellied inkwell with a narrower neck and flat-ish lid; instantly readable as a bottle/well, not a modern pen cartridge
markings: Faint etched band around the shoulder—old maker's marks, not glowing runes by default
No loud logos; no cartoon stickers
When active, etchings may catch light as thin white line-art highlights (not neon)

lid.style: Snug circular lid with a small rounded knob
lid.story_rule: Major Echo effects require the lid open with intent; closed lid helps collapse unstable spaces

age_weathering: Looks decades old: soft brass dullness, micro-chips at the glass base edge, interior ink stains on the neck; cared for, not filthy
supernatural_visual_characteristics: Active: ink surface may ripple against gravity; faint line-echo rings in air above the mouth
Crossing moment: thin ink filaments or outline sparkles connecting well to page
Low ink: visible shallow pool; light catches empty glass belly
Never depicted as shooting laser beams or casting large fireballs
when_effects_appear: Lid opened with deliberate creative intent
Brush or tool dips and first committed stroke lands
A drawing finishes and an Echo stabilizes
Unstable unfinished emotion causes leak (drip upward, mist, corner shadows)
Drawing-space open while well is nearby and creator is focused

line_art_effect_representation.preferred: Sparse speed-lines, shimmer hatch, outline glow as broken white contour, ink-ripple concentric circles
line_art_effect_representation.avoid: Heavy screentone storms that obscure the object; rainbow gradients; lens-flare blobs
line_art_effect_representation.coloring_book_note: Effects must remain optional line suggestions so the Inkwell shape stays easy to color

must_remain_constant: Round-bellied glass silhouette with neck and lid
Readable size relative to Kaito's hands
Ink is black-dominant (may shimmer, not recolor into candy hues as default)
prohibited_variations: Turning into a fountain pen, smartphone, or unrelated artifact mid-story
Changing into a huge cauldron or tiny perfume sample
Adding wings, faces, or chibi limbs to the Inkwell itself
Unlimited glowing power aura that never depletes
Inventing on-disk reference images that do not exist
